scope: small European ground or close-range SfM deposits
exposed natural peat, sand, rock, gravel, or eroded-soil surfaces

candidates.title: Terrestrial laser scanning point clouds of the Isar river bed near Wallgau acquired in August and November 2024

raw_points_or_images.reason: The manifest exposes co-aligned LAZ products, not original scan positions or another raw acquisition product.

surface_masks_or_vegetation_free_aoi.reason: No water, vegetation, object, occlusion, interpolation, or exact usable-surface mask is published or promised.

independent_numeric_control.reason: M3C2 change output and its parameter file compare the two aligned surfaces; they are not independent checkpoint or control evidence, and the record gives no numeric registration error.

reusable_rights.reason: CC-BY-4.0 permits reuse and adaptation with attribution.

candidates.title: Structure-from-Motion photogrammetry data of topographic changes from seven erosion plots on Iron Tongue Hill, Tameside, UK, 2018-2019

raw_points_or_images.reason: The lineage describes 40-60 photographs and a dense cloud per survey, but the official distribution promises only exported DEM and orthomosaic TIFF products.

surface_masks_or_vegetation_free_aoi.reason: The record neither declares the plots vegetation-free nor publishes an exact soil, vegetation, object, occlusion, or interpolation mask.

independent_numeric_control.reason: Field dGPS GCPs are described only as scale and georeference inputs; no held-out checkpoint roles, coordinates, residuals, or independent reference surface are promised.

reusable_rights.reason: The official record distributes the resource under the Open Government Licence.

excluded_before_evaluation.reason: The official deposit is a monolithic processed point-cloud download without a member manifest, so it violates the search entry policy.

decision.reason: Neither admissible candidate jointly publishes acquisition-level geometry, exact usable-surface semantics, and independent numeric control. Reusable licensing alone cannot qualify morphology evidence.
decision.resume_condition: Resume only for a new small, individually manifested official field deposit that explicitly binds raw points or images, an exact vegetation-free usable surface or machine mask, independent numeric control evidence, and reusable rights to the same acquisition.
